verdict.rationale: USPTO's own pages say Trademark Center is where you file a new trademark application and pay application fees [uspto-docs-1]. Patent Center accepts DOCX/PDF filings with separate submission and payment receipts [uspto-docs-10, uspto-docs-14], and online payment by card, deposit account or EFT is documented [uspto-docs-17]. A USPTO.gov account with MFA and identity verification is required first, but that verification can itself be completed online [uspto-supp-1, uspto-docs-3]; missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a founder completed an end-to-end online filing and payment.
